summary: The parent guardian emphasizes the importance of the E-Rate program for libraries and schools in Montgomery County, Maryland, stating that without E-Rate funding, MCPL and MCPS would have to cut core services, programs, and operations to maintain internet service. They highlight the critical role of E-Rate in providing secure, scalable, future-ready connectivity for libraries and schools, enabling digital literacy training, internet access, and technology support for the community.
